# Rameshwar Engineers 
## Overview
Rameshwar Engineers is an industrial manufacturing facility specializing in precision tool engineering, heavy-duty automotive component manufacturing, sheet metal forming dies, and high-capacity VMC machining infrastructure.

## Core Capabilities
- **Die & Tooling Design**: Specialized manufacturing of sheet metal drawing, trimming, piercing, and complex hot-forming dies.
- **Automotive Components**: Heavy gauge component manufacturing, with high-volume production lines for axle housings and automotive banjo casings (ranging from 4mm to 14mm thickness).
- **VMC Precision Machining**: Machining components utilizing large-envelope vertical machining centers.
- **CAD & Simulation**: Comprehensive tooling design, die cavity rendering, and finite element forming simulation validation.

## Technical Architecture & Design Tokens
The digital assets are structured around a high-performance, responsive single-page architecture built with custom semantic layout systems.

### Color Tokens (CSS Variables)
- Primary Accent: `#913420` (Industrial Amber / Steel Oxide)
- Base Surface: `#ffffff` (Main canvases)
- Utility Surface: `#f5f6f7` / `#eef0f2` (Structured UI sections)
- Borders & Rules: `#e2e5e9` (Steel Line divider token)
- Accent Highlights: `#ffc72c` / `#141414` (Hazard Striping Configuration)

### Typography Stack
- Headings & Displays: `Oswald`, sans-serif
- Body Interface: `Inter`, sans-serif
- Technical Specifications / Code: `JetBrains Mono`, monospace

## System Assets & Route Inventory
- `/index.html`: Main corporate landing ecosystem, containing the Hero Showcase, Capabilities Matrix, Product Gallery Grid, Client Index, and RFQ/Contact Interface.
- `/404.html`: Custom system exception handler with integrated automatic 15-second safety routing fallback logic.
- `/assets/images/logo.png`: Primary brand asset.

## Integration Protocols
- **Product Gallery**: Implements a clean, dynamic CSS Grid (`auto-fill`, min-width `280px`) with integrated attribute filters (`data-cat="axle|dies|cad|machining"`), optimized image lazy-loading, and a custom JavaScript-driven image lightbox overlay.
- **Customer Logotypes**: Responsive unified grayscale flexbox grid (`minmax(160px, 1fr)`) featuring state-driven CSS transitions to brand color matrices on user focus/hover actions.
